title: 038 · Reshipment after return to sender
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Sella Nove. From the case card: the failed original delivery of DL-038 is physically back at the merchant, and the customer still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the merchant's approval to reship the order to the customer's verified destination.

customer.name: Sella Nove
customer.responsibility: Confirm that she still wants the order and that the stored destination is correct.

warehouse.name: Warehouse returns
warehouse.responsibility: Confirm that the returned item is back in stock and reshippable.

merchant.name: Reshipment authorisations
merchant.responsibility: Approve the reshipment and create the new shipment.

goal: Get the merchant's approval to reship the returned order to the customer's verified destination and a new shipment reference.
limits: Do not treat the new shipment reference as proof of dispatch or receipt.
Do not reuse the old delivered status for the new shipment.

intake.summary: Reship the DL-038 order to the customer's verified destination: the original delivery failed and the item is back at the merchant.
